questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

17, 19, 22, 24, 27, ?
questions.solution:
The relation between the numbers is as follows,

17 + 2 = 19

19 + 3 = 22

22 + 2 = 24

24 + 3 = 27

27 + 2 = 29

Hence, the next number is 29.

questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

14, 21, 35, 56, 84, ?
questions.solution:
The relation between the numbers is as follows,

7 × 2 = 14

7 × (2 + 1) = 7 × 3 = 21

7 × (3 + 2) = 7 × 5 = 35

7 × (5 + 3) = 7 × 8 = 56

7 × (8 + 4) = 7 × 12 = 84

7 × (12 + 5) = 7 × 17 = 119

Hence, the next number is 119.

2, 3, 10, 39, ?, 1175
questions.solution:
The relation between the numbers is as follows,

2 × 2 – 1 = 3

3 × 3 + 1 = 9 + 1 = 10

10 × 4 – 1 = 40 – 1 = 39

39 × 5 + 1 = 195 + 1 = 196

196 × 6 – 1 = 1176 – 1 = 1175

Hence, the missing number is 196.

questions.question: In the following question, select the odd number pair from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
Out of the given options, 10 – 90 is odd one because in all other options 2ⁿd term is the product of 1st term and (1st term + 1) i.e.

12 – 156 → 12 × 13 = 156

6 – 42 → 6 × 7 = 42

8 – 72 → 8 × 9 = 72

But in 10 – 90 → 10 × 11 = 110 which is not equal to 90.

Thus, 10 – 90 is odd one.

questions.question:
What will come in place of question mark (?) in the given equation?

9 ? 11 ? 6 ? 3 ? 9 = 117
questions.solution:
The given equation is: 9 ? 11 ? 6 ? 3 ? 9 = 117

Let’s check each option,

x, –, + and ÷ → 9 x 11 – 6 + 3 ÷ 9 = 93.33 ≠ 117

+, –, ÷ and x → 9 + 11 – 6 ÷ 3 × 9 = 2 ≠ 117

x, +, ÷ and x → 9 × 11 + 6 ÷ 3 × 9 = 117 = 117

x, ÷, + and – → 9 × 11 ÷ 6 + 3 – 9 = 10.5 ≠ 117

Hence, by putting “×, +, ÷ and ×” in place of question mark (?) the equation will be correct.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements: **

I. All cups are plates.

II. All plates are red.

**Conclusions: **

I. All cups are red.

II. All plates are cups.

III. All red are plates.
questions.solution:
Consider the following least possible Venn diagram, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9745d27301476d87f8f80b69605f127e73d43e44d667d6f60c79a64e3f35324a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All cups are red → True (It is definitely true as shown in the diagram).

II. All plates are cups → False (It is possible but not definite).

III. All red are plates → False (It is possible but not definite).

Hence, only conclusion I follows.

questions.question: Present ages of Richa and her husband are in ratio 3 : 4. Five years from now, ages of her husband and her son will be in ratio 3 : 1. If the present age of Richa is 21 years, then what will be her son’s present age (in years)?
questions.solution:
Present age of Richa is 21 years.

Let the present age of Richa’s husband and her son be ‘H’ and ‘S’ respectively.

Ratio of ages of Richa and her husband is 3 : 4.

frac{{21}}{H} = (3)/(4)

H = 28

Age of Richa’s husband after five years = 28 + 5 = 33

Ratio of ages of her husband and her son after five year is 3 : 1

frac{{33}}{{( {S + 5} )}} = (3)/(1) to S = 11 - 5 = 6

Thus, present age of Richa’s son is 6 years.

Present age of A is 2 times that of B i.e.

a = 2 × b

a = 2 × 39 = 78 years

Hence,

Thus, present age of A is 78 years.
